_review: T071 draft. English is final; Tamil needs native review.
title: Social
sub: Organic reach and engagement for your connected Instagram and Facebook accounts, next to your paid ads. Counts only: no commenter names or comment text are stored.
sampleBand: Sample data. Nothing here is read from Instagram or Facebook.
refreshQueuedSub: The numbers update when the sync finishes, usually within a minute.
timelineHelp: One mark per post. Height is reach, colour is the kind of post. Posts with no reported reach sit on the baseline.
emptyBody: Your accounts are connected. Posts and numbers appear after the first sync, which runs every 3 hours.
notConnectedBody: Connect your Meta account, then choose the Facebook Page and linked Instagram account to track.
approvalBody: Meta has not yet granted the insights permissions this page needs. Post numbers stay hidden until it does; nothing is shown as live without them.
attentionBody: Meta rejected the saved access. Reconnect it from Integrations; the numbers below are from the last successful sync.
deniedTitle: You do not have access to analytics
deniedBody: Ask a workspace owner to give you the Analytics permission.
errorMessage: The numbers could not be read just now. Try again in a moment.
syncNoteTitle: Last sync did not return everything
syncNoteNoData: {name}: connected, but Meta returned no data. {detail}
syncNotePartial: {name}: some data could not be read. {detail}
partialLabel: Meta had no insights for some posts yet; they show as not reported, not zero.
sheetCurveHelp: Each point is the latest snapshot for that day.
sheetNoCurve: No daily numbers for this post yet.
pickHelp: Pick the Facebook Page. Its linked Instagram account is tracked with it. Add more accounts by connecting again.
pickNoPages: Meta returned no Facebook Pages for this login. Reconnect, choose Edit access, tick your Page, and make sure you are an admin of it.
pickFailNotConfigured: The Meta app is not configured on this deployment.
pickFailToken: Meta rejected the access token. Reconnect and try again.
pickFailNotManaged: That Page is not managed by the connected Meta user.
pickFailTaken: That account is already connected to another workspace.
